arousal-valence.definition: two rating scales for emotion: arousal runs from calm to excited and valence from unpleasant to pleasant; in DEAM each is a nine-point scale averaged over crowd raters
arousal-valence.excludes: named emotions such as sadness or nostalgia, which the ratings place only as points on the two scales

perceived-emotion.definition: the emotion a listener judges the music to express, as opposed to the emotion the listener feels
perceived-emotion.excludes: felt or induced emotion, physiological response and any change in mood or symptoms

onset-tail.definition: for each note onset found in the energy envelope, the time constant of the envelope's decay from its peak to the next minimum, with the median taken over onsets; it follows whichever of the note's own decay and the room's decay is slower
onset-tail.excludes: the reverberation time of the room on its own, which this measure cannot separate in dense music

spectral-slope.definition: the slope of log power against log frequency between 110 Hz and 5.5 kHz; a more negative slope means energy leans toward low frequencies and the sound is darker
spectral-slope.excludes: pitch, loudness and the shape of the spectrum beyond its overall tilt

partial-correlation.definition: the correlation between two quantities after each has had the linear effect of a set of control variables removed by least squares
partial-correlation.excludes: a causal effect, and any non-linear dependence on the controls

held-out.definition: data kept apart from everything that was fitted or standardised, here every clip by 30 percent of the artists, so that a result on it is a check on new material
held-out.excludes: data used to fit the model, choose a threshold or compute a scaling

r2-gain.definition: the share of variance in the test outcome explained by a model fitted on training data with the added measures, minus the same share for the model without them
r2-gain.excludes: the in-sample R2 of a fit, which can only grow as variables are added

cluster-bootstrap.definition: a bootstrap that resamples whole groups, here artists with all their clips, so that clips by one artist count as one draw
cluster-bootstrap.excludes: a bootstrap over single clips, which treats one artist's clips as independent
